Muzzle loaders come in two flavors, traditional and modern. Depending on what you want to do and the experience you get from it is where you need to make your choice.

Traditional muzzle loaders are your general cap and ball type "davy crocket" thing. You throw some power down the hole, shove a patch and a ball down the barrel and shoot. These can be, I don't want to say inaccurate, but not as accurate as a modern muzzle loader. If you want to shoot on a league, buy a traditional. They also give you that "authentic" feel.

Modern muzzle loaders are a cheat. They are for all purposes A RIFLE that is accurate and easy to use. They are for the hunter that wants to extend his deer season. They use a variety of conical projectiles and depending on the model a reliable ignition like a shotgun primer instead of a cap. You can also buy pyrodex pellets to use instead of power, I don't care for them but I can't argue that they aren't easy.

Traditional- fun, authentic, great care and cleaning required and not as accurate

Modern- easy, reliable, accurate
